_note: Source of truth for the 30 days. Planned entries come from the plan doc; a daily run flips the next one to built.

days.title: Departure Poster
days.build: A Swiss grid hero whose letters flip like split-flap tiles to spell the headline
days.detail: Staggered flips with a slight overshoot

days.title: Orbit Nav
days.build: Nav labels orbiting a central word on elliptical paths, speeding up as you get near
days.detail: Labels at the back of an orbit shrink and blur

days.title: Tide Footer
days.build: A footer wordmark in water that rises as you reach the bottom, with links bobbing on it
days.detail: A refraction line at the waterline

days.title: Halftone Weather
days.build: A halftone portrait whose dots thicken and thin like clouds drifting over it
days.detail: The cursor works like sunlight and clears the dots

days.title: Sticky Recipe
days.spark: The sticky product scroll with GSAP
days.build: A pinned bowl that fills with ingredients as each step scrolls past
days.detail: Monospace quantities that tick up

days.title: Dithered Snow Globe
days.build: A 1-bit dithered Three.js globe you shake by dragging
days.detail: The snow settles with real inertia

days.title: Remix: Halftone Board
days.build: Split-flap tiles that flip to form a halftone image
days.detail: Image and type share one grid

days.title: Ember Pricing
days.build: Three plans in one vermilion. The chosen plan heats like a coal and throws sparks, the one you leave cools slowly
days.detail: A heat haze on hover that moves the surface, never the text

days.title: Instant Film
days.spark: The "good light" photo posts and View Transitions from card to page
days.build: A table of instant prints. Opening one lifts it into a full page, where it lands with a small shake and develops from milky grey into colour
days.detail: Shadows come up before colour, like real instant film

days.title: Field Notes
days.spark: The clean UI blueprint (four type sizes, three greys)
days.build: Six specimen cards held strictly to that system, with a naturalist's notes that write themselves on when you hover
days.detail: Each stroke is timed by its length and each word by its letters, so notes go on at pen speed

days.title: Stained Glass
days.build: Scroll and a pointed window assembles from about a thousand loose pieces of glass, then the sun comes round and throws its colours onto the wall below
days.detail: The coloured light drifts across the text as the sun moves

days.title: Radio Dial Nav
days.build: A dial nav where turning it scrambles labels like static until a page locks in
days.detail: A faint static grain while tuning

days.title: Murmuration
days.twist: A flock of starlings at dusk
days.build: Five thousand birds flock across a dusk sky, gather into a word for a few seconds, then scatter
days.technique: Three.js Points with a chevron shader, boids on a uniform grid
days.detail: The cursor is a hawk: birds swerve away from it, even mid-word

days.title: Remix: Flocking Recipe
days.build: Ingredients made of flocking particles that pour into the pinned bowl
days.detail: Each step's particles have their own colour

days.title: Film Strip
days.build: Scrolling scrubs a horizontal film strip, and the current frame plays in a viewer
days.detail: Sprocket holes and a running frame counter

days.title: Ink in Water
days.build: Images change by blooming like ink clouds out from the cursor
days.detail: The ink keeps spreading after you stop

days.title: Zoomable Diary
days.build: Zoom from a year heatmap into a month, then a day, then an hour's notes
days.detail: Labels swap levels smoothly and never overlap

days.title: Loom Loader
days.build: Threads weave across the screen into the brand pattern as loading progresses
days.detail: The threads wobble slightly under tension

days.title: Tree Rings
days.build: Pinned stats where each new number adds a ring to a growing tree cross-section
days.detail: Tabular numbers and real ring texture

days.title: Constellation Mark
days.build: A logo that morphs through star-map shapes as you scroll, redrawing its lines
days.detail: Smooth in-between shapes with no twisting

days.title: Remix: Ink Diary
days.build: The zoomable diary, with ink blooms between zoom levels
days.detail: Ink colour follows the mood of each day

days.title: Pointillist Weather
days.build: A map painted in brush dots, where colour shows temperature
days.detail: The dots lean with the wind direction

days.title: Glass Cabinet
days.build: A product inside a glass case that you drag to rotate, with its label card bending behind the glass
days.detail: Subtle dust and reflections on the glass

days.title: Paper Unfold
days.build: Sections that unfold like paper as they enter view, with no JavaScript
days.detail: Shading on the folds and a reduced-motion fallback

days.title: Spellbook Palette
days.build: A command palette where results are spells with rune icons, and running one plays a small effect
days.detail: The highlight glides smoothly between results

days.title: Sound Terrain
days.build: Dithered terrain whose hills rise and fall with the bass of a song
days.detail: Contour lines that shift with the sound

days.title: Eclipse Clock
days.build: A ring of bent light that tells the time, with the glowing disk turning through the hours
days.detail: The bright side of the disk acts as the minute hand

days.title: Remix: Spell Sky
days.build: The spellbook palette floating over the eclipse clock as a live backdrop
days.detail: Keep 60fps on a laptop

days.title: Showcase build
days.build: One page linking all 28 pieces on the Day 1 split-flap grid
days.detail: Live hover previews

days.title: Polish and publish
days.build: Polish performance, accessibility and share images, then publish
days.detail: Every piece loads in under 2s
